question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**production**" means the process of creating, manufacturing, or generating something, in this case, plastic. (उत्पादन)
 
• In the context of the passage, "global production of primary plastic" refers to the worldwide manufacturing or creation of new plastic material.
 
• The other options: "**accommodation**" (housing or lodging), "**substance**" (material or matter), and "**energy**" (power or force) do not fit the context as appropriately as "production".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** We are seeing other worrying trends. By the 1970s, the rate of plastic production has grown faster than that of any other material. If historic growth trends continue, global production__ of primary plastic is forecasted to reach 1,100 million tonnes by 2050.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Accommodation (आवास)**: A place where someone may live or stay.
 
• **Substance (पदार्थ)**: A type of matter with a particular composition and properties.
 
• **Energy (ऊर्जा)**: The capacity for doing work or generating power.
